answer: Reaching the pigment of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the tundra of a task receipt, and the walnut is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, unlocked only after continuous uptime. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
